note: What a server sends to confirm an item reached a slot.

fields.name: item
fields.note: Which item, by the number the client knows it as.

fields.name: inSlot
fields.note: How many of it are in that slot now.

bits.name: tellTheClient
bits.note: Set where the client is to show the change.

bits.name: unknown
bits.note: Purpose undetermined. A server leaves these as it found them, so they carry values it never wrote for this message.
